name: authentik-mod
description: Manage an authentik 2026.8 instance from Claude Code: an MCP server with tools for users, groups, applications, providers, outposts, flows, events, crypto, policies, sources, RBAC, blueprints, system and branding, a skill, and /authentik. Dependencies install on first use; the URL and token are asked for at install time and the token goes to the keychain.

authentik_url.title: authentik URL
authentik_url.description: Base URL of your authentik, for example https://auth.example.com (https required).

authentik_token.title: authentik API token
authentik_token.description: API token (intent: API, not app password) of a service account whose role holds only the permissions you want Claude to have. See the plugin README.

read_only.title: Read-only
read_only.description: Only register tools that read. Nothing can be created, changed or deleted.

enabled_domains.title: Enabled domains
enabled_domains.description: Comma-separated tool domains to turn on.

allow_flows_admin.title: Allow editing flows and stages
allow_flows_admin.description: Turn on the tools that create, change or delete flows, stages and stage bindings. A broken authentication flow can lock everyone out, so this is off by default.

max_page_items.title: Max items per list
max_page_items.description: Upper limit of items one list call returns.

default_authorization_flow.title: Default authorization flow
default_authorization_flow.description: Slug used for new OAuth2, SAML and proxy providers when none is given.

default_invalidation_flow.title: Default invalidation flow
default_invalidation_flow.description: Slug used for new providers when none is given.

css_allowed_hosts.title: Allowed hosts in custom CSS
css_allowed_hosts.description: Comma-separated hosts that custom brand CSS may load fonts or images from.
